lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured array of at least five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters. The central visible row features approximately six equidistant local maxima with consistent spatial intervals between the branchial region and the dorsal fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid. High-luminance blobs are precisely positioned at the geometric intersections of these vertical and horizontal intensity gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal features exhibiting a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient (light superior edge, shadowed inferior edge) run parallel along the lateral flank, delineating the physical curvature of the shark's midsection.
